about_the_game:
CoopRooms is a cooperative survival horror experience that plunges you and up to four other players into the endless, mind-bending corridors of the Backrooms. With realistic visuals, terrifying spatial audio, and dynamic proximity voice chat, you’ll need to stay together, solve puzzles, and navigate through an ever-changing nightmare—before something finds you.

  • 5-player online co-op: Team up with friends or try to make it out solo.

  • Dynamic proximity voice chat: Your voice fades through walls and distances—if you lose your team, you might be on your own.

  • Public and private lobbies: Play with friends or face the unknown with total strangers.

Unexpected horror: Watch your teammates panic, disappear, or lead something straight to you.

The monsters don’t just hunt you—they hear you. Unlike any other Backrooms game, the enemies react to your real voice. Your microphone becomes a tool for survival, as your screams, whispers, and conversations may attract their attention.

Built with Unreal Engine 5, CoopRooms delivers hyper-realistic graphics, unsettling soundscapes, and dynamic lighting that make the Backrooms feel disturbingly real. Every flickering light, distant echo, and distorted shadow adds to the overwhelming tension.

The further you go, the less you’ll trust your own senses.


Nothing stays the same. Every hallway, every room, every turn is procedurally generated, ensuring that no two playthroughs are ever alike. The layout rearranges itself each time you enter, making escape feel impossible and keeping you in constant suspense.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 ／ Intel Core i5-7500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 470 with 4GB VRAM ／ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 ／ Intel Core i7 8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700／ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
